template.name: Network

transition.label: p : producer_id
net_tx[p]?
packet = outgoing[p], owner = p, x = 0, status[outgoing[p].id] = 1, admitted++

template.name: Producer

transition.label: outgoing[p].id = p * PACKETS_PER_PRODUCER + next, outgoing[p].src = p, outgoing[p].dst = 1 - p, outgoing[p].kind = p, outgoing[p].payload = next + 2 * p, expected[outgoing[p].id] = outgoing[p], pending[p] = true, wait = 0

template.name: Receiver

transition.label: net_rx[id]?

integrityError = integrityError || status[incoming.id] != 1 || incoming.src != expected[incoming.id].src || incoming.dst != expected[incoming.id].dst || incoming.kind != expected[incoming.id].kind || incoming.payload != expected[incoming.id].payload || incoming.dst != id || deliveries[incoming.id] != 0, deliveries[incoming.id]++, status[incoming.id] = 2, delivered++

query.comment: N1: Reachability: a packet can be delivered.
N2: Reachability: a packet can be lost. Saved runs: NOT satisfied with LOSS_MODE = 0, satisfied with 1 and 2.
N3: Reachability: both producers wait while the link is busy, so they really compete for the slot.
N4: Safety: every delivered packet has the fields it was sent with, reaches the right receiver and arrives once.
N5: Safety: no test packet is delivered twice.
N6: Accounting: every packet the link took is in flight, delivered or lost.
N7: Accounting: status 2 (delivered) always matches exactly one delivery.

query.formula: A[] ((Link.Delivered || Link.Lost) imply (Link.x >= D_MIN && Link.x <= D_MAX))
query.comment: N8: Timing: delivery or loss happens between D_MIN and D_MAX after the link takes the packet.
N9: Timing: the link clock never goes over D_MAX. This restates the invariant, so it only means something together with N10 and N11.
N10: Liveness: a packet in the link always leaves it (delivered or lost).

query.formula: A[] (deadlock imply (Sender0.Done && Sender1.Done && Link.Idle && delivered + lost == N_PACKETS))
query.comment: N11: The only deadlock is the normal end of the test: both senders done, link idle, all packets delivered or lost.
N12: Reachability: all four packets can be delivered.
N13: Liveness: every run ends with all test packets delivered or lost.
N14: Bounded loss: with K_LOSS = 1 no producer loses both of its packets. Only a real test with LOSS_MODE = 2, trivially true otherwise.
N15: Reachability: all packets can be lost. Saved runs: satisfied only with LOSS_MODE = 1.

query.formula: A[] forall (i : packet_id) (status[i] == 1 imply (Link.Transmitting && Link.packet.id == i))
query.comment: N16: Safety: a packet with status 1 is the one the link is holding right now.
N17: Safety: a lost packet was never delivered.
N18: Measure: longest time producer 1 waits before the link takes its packet (admission wait, not transmission time). Saved runs: 9 with D_MAX = 3, 15 with D_MAX = 5.
